max_time_steps.description: Maximum number of time steps for the simulation

description.description: Human-readable description of the test case

type.description: Kind of location this node represents (defaults to travel)

capacity.description: Maximum number of drive units that may occupy this node or be in transit toward it at the same time (unlimited if not specified)

from_node.description: ID of one endpoint of the edge

to_node.description: ID of the other endpoint of the edge

weight.description: Weight/length of the edge (time steps required to traverse)

capacity.description: Maximum number of drive units that may be traversing this edge at the same time, both directions combined (unlimited if not specified)

bidirectional.description: Whether the edge can be traversed in both directions (defaults to true)

id.description: Unique identifier for the drive unit

start_node.description: ID of the node where the drive unit starts

capacity.description: Maximum number of pods the drive unit can carry at once (defaults to 1)

source_node.description: ID of the node where the pod appears

destination_station.description: ID of the station node the pod must be delivered to

entry_time.description: Time step when the pod enters the system
